environment.description: Same Flask application deployed behind an AWS Application Load Balancer with a listener rule on port 443 configured with mutual TLS (mTLS) verification mode set to 'verify' against a custom trust store (arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:us-east-1:123456789012:truststore/internal-ca-bundle/abc123). The trust store contains only the organization's internal PKI intermediate CA certificate (CN=InternalServices-ICA-2024, O=AcmeCorp). The ALB listener rule evaluates mTLS BEFORE any target group forwarding occurs - connections without a valid client certificate signed by the trusted CA chain receive a 400 error at the TLS handshake level and never reach the Flask application. The ALB access logs show the field 'tls_client_cert_subject' is populated for all forwarded requests. Additionally, the target group health check path is /healthz which does not require authentication as it's handled at a different listener rule on port 8080 (internal only). The migration endpoint is only reachable via the port 443 listener with mTLS enforced.

config.load_balancer: AWS ALB with mTLS listener (verify mode)
